text: Open the ARAW link or icon. Pick your language, press SELECT, then press START.
Tap Arcade for short games. Not sure how? Watch the game's video. Tap, click, or use the arrow keys.
The very first screen asks for your language. ARAW speaks English, Filipino, Cebuano, Ilokano and Hiligaynon. Tap a language card, then press SELECT.
ARAW is an AIKasalig project. These are the project partners: DOST, DOST-PCHRD, National University, NICER and AIKasalig.

The Library is for reading and watching at your own pace. It has four parts: Myths, Dictionary, Comics and Videos.

The translations are new. If a word looks wrong, use Report to tell us.

ARAW is part of AIKasalig, a project on responsible AI in Philippine health care, under the DOST-NICER R&D Center on Natural Language Processing for Health Applications at National University. Open About the project from Me (or from the left side on a computer) to read more.
